speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
text: asked 	the Minister for Home Affairs whether the Government will prosecute hirers of rental bicycles who damage, dismantle or dispose of bicycles illegally or convert them for their own use.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: This approach is no different from how we deal with other offences.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: However, prosecution by itself will not eliminate the problem of misuse or abuse of the rental bicycles.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The bicycle rental companies and the hirers have to take responsibility to ensure the appropriate use of the rental bicycles.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Surely, the Police ought to take punitive action.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: If we do nothing, then it may be seen that we are tolerating, we are accepting behaviour that totally disregards the rights of the owners of bicycles.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: If we allow such behaviour to continue, then, today, it may be those bike-sharing companies; tomorrow, it will be some other illegal activity.
